# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:claude/claude-opus-4-6

## Summary

Thorough review of the CO2 gas exchange integration. Verified: (1) all unit conversions correct across the entire chain (mol↔mmol↔mg C, mg CO2); (2) gas exchange formula dimensionally consistent and correctly modifies DIC without touching alkalinity; (3) K_LA(CO2) correctly derived from K_LA(O2)×0.91 with shared SA/V normalization; (4) Euler stability cap applied independently at usage site; (5) DIC double-protected against negative values; (6) carbonate equilibrium re-solved after DIC mutation; (7) budget guard properly exempts chemistry's open-system atmospheric flux; (8) chemistry and DO engine steps are independent with no circular dependency; (9) Henry's law with van 't Hoff temperature correction produces correct equilibrium (~0.61 mg CO2/L at 25°C); (10) pKa1 formula matches Harned & Davis 1943. All 12 CO2 exchange tests pass. No bugs, safety problems, or correctness gaps found.

## Amendments

None.
